text:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated 5xx rate observed from streaming-gateway (us-east-1) — impact: P2. Alerts: 502 spike + client disconnects. Runbook: <https://redwood.runbooks/streaming-5xx|streaming-5xx>

emma (oncall): acknowledged. looking now. can someone post a short summary of user impact?

alice: seeing 502 and 504 from gateway to fanout-proxy  — spike started ~10:15 UTC. TLDR: ~12% of active streams returning early EOF or 502s.

bob: metrics: gateway error-rate 5xx from 0.6% -> 6.8% over last 8m. upstream fanout latency also increased 3x.

clare: customer-impact: a few enterprise customers on dedicated nodes reported truncated streams and UI refresh loops. CS triage notified.

dave: quick check: is this the chunked-encoding regression we patched last week? any deploys in the last hour?

platform-ops: deploy bot: "deploy/streaming-gateway v2.14.3 -> v2.14.4" finished 9m ago by ci/cd.

emma (oncall): thanks. lets assume latest deploy is suspect. rolling mitigation options: 1) route traffic to canary-less older revision, 2) enable per-connection heartbeat to keep proxies from closing, 3) temporary scaling. prefer quick fallback.

alice: logs show repeated: `http: panic serving connection: unexpected EOF` from fanout-proxy and intermittent `write tcp: connection reset by peer`.

bob: sample logs:
```
2026-02-11T10:16:02Z gateway request_id=xyz upstream=fanout-proxy-3 status=502 err="chunked write failure: write: connection reset by peer"
2026-02-11T10:16:03Z fanout-proxy-3 stderr: runtime: signal SIGPIPE
```

clare: I ran `curl -v` against the gateway for a long-poll stream, got chunked frames then abrupt CLOSE with `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway`.

dave: can we flip routing to `streaming-gateway:v2.14.2` for us-east-1 only? that should be fast via routing policy.

emma (oncall): @platform-ops please prepare rollback route; @eng-sre help validate diagnostics so we don't mask root cause. set mitigation TTL 30m.

platform-ops: prepared route change, can push to traffic-router in ~2m. will throttle by region.

eng-sre: quick triage checklist: check upstream keepalive settings, observe TCP RST counts, check kernel logs on fanout-proxy nodes for SIGPIPE/regressions. also inspect reverse-proxy config for `chunked_transfer_encoding` handling.

customer-support: ongoing CS escalation for 3 paying customers (acct-431, acct-872, acct-930). letting them know we're investigating and will apply mitigation.

emma (oncall): applying controlled routing rollback now (us-east-1 only). notifying on-call pager. ETA 90s.

incident-bot: ACTION: traffic-router change initiated by emma — shift 100% gateway traffic in us-east-1 from v2.14.4 -> v2.14.2 (canary to stable). Change ID: tr-7782.

alice: early telemetry: 60s after change error-rate decreased from 6.8% -> 1.9%. disconnects reduced but not fully resolved.

bob: additional telemetry: backend fanout CPU on a subset of nodes spiked; kernel logs show `epoll: epoll_wait` backlog then `connection reset` bursts.

dave: possible hypothesis: v2.14.4 introduced different socket flush ordering under backpressure causing SIGPIPE on some kernel versions. need to repro with backpressure harness.

emma (oncall): ok. mitigation step 1 successful (rollback). Next steps: keep rollback 30m, enable increased connection timeout and heartbeat on gateway to avoid client cancels (non-breaking). also gather traces for affected requests (request_ids).

eng-sre: list of request ids to collect: xyz*, abc*, 7z9* — will collect from logs & tracing.

platform-ops: increased gateway `streaming_heartbeat_interval` from 0 -> 15s for us-east-1 (hotfix) — applied.

customer-support: messaging update sent to impacted customers: "We observed transient truncated streams and increased failures in us-east-1. We've rolled back a recent gateway change and applied a hotfix; reductions seen. We'll follow up with root cause."

emma (oncall): monitoring window 30m. please escalate if >2% 5xx persists or if additional regions show regression.

clare: can we tag impacted traces and run through the regression test suite (chunked-encoding, client-cancel) before promoting v2.14.4 again? I can own the regression test job.

alice: created ephemeral job: `make test-e2e-backpressure` in ci with simulated slow downstream. queued now.

bob: one more note: some clients are using `Connection: close` incorrectly and that exacerbates symptoms — but not primary cause. we should include retry guidance in interim KB.

dave: for RCA: collect kernel versions across fanout nodes, confirm whether v2.14.4 toggled `SO_LINGER` behavior, and run a patch that guards against SIGPIPE by ignoring it or using robust writes.

emma (oncall): decision log: rollback + heartbeat applied; hold for 30m; if stable, we'll keep rollback and schedule a deeper rollback/patch release. if unstable, escalate to SEV1.

incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE: 10m window post-mitigation 5xx avg=1.2% (down from 6.8%). client-cancels reduced to baseline.

platform-ops: rollback TTL set to 30m. will prepare a canary build v2.14.4-rc1 with additional socket guards.

customer-support: will run a follow-up message with timeline and ETA for RCA.

emma (oncall): handing off to eng-sre for deep-dive. @eng-sre please own RCA and post an incident summary when done. I'll remain available.

eng-sre: taking. timeline: start triage -> reproduce in staging -> confirm patch -> schedule release. expected follow-up within 8 hours.

clare: note for postmortem: add a check in CI for ephemeral `SIGPIPE` under backpressure and an SLO test for streaming continuity at 99.9%.

emma (oncall): thanks team. closing live mitigation loop. moving thread to post-incident channel once RCA doc ready. :thumbsup:
